metadata.title: SEPTA Accelerate projects
metadata.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

geometry_precision_values.approx_station: Hand-entered coordinates, typically within ~100-300 m. Snap to GTFS stops before district joins.
geometry_precision_values.line_schematic: Line drawn through approximate station coordinates or a few waypoints; not track-accurate.
geometry_precision_values.corridor_schematic: Street corridor drawn from a few approximate waypoints; extent partly assumed (see location_note).
geometry_precision_values.endpoints_only: Named endpoints only; alignment not given in the source.
geometry_precision_values.none: No location in the source (systemwide or unnamed sites); geometry is null.

metadata.status_values: proposed | underway | underway (procurement) | completed | status not stated

properties.name: Transit Police expansion
properties.description: Expand Transit Police to 220 uniformed officers with data-driven deployment.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: 30 in 30 station deep cleaning
properties.description: Deep clean 30 stations every 30 days.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Pit-crew vehicle cleaning at line ends
properties.description: Pit-crew style cleaning of B and L vehicles at line terminals.
properties.location_note: Terminals assumed: 69th St, Frankford TC, Fern Rock TC, NRG
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Full-height fare gates
properties.description: Full-height fare gates: piloted at 69th Street, deployed at nine more stations, expanding to 13 more Metro stations over the next year.
properties.location_note: Only the 69th St pilot is named; the other 22 stations are not identified in the document.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Accessible wayfinding and signage
properties.description: New accessible wayfinding vocabulary and signage; in place at 28 B Line stations and across Center City, 26 more stations over 18 months.
properties.location_note: The 26 upcoming stations are not named.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Tasker-Morris Station upgrade
properties.description: Elevators street-to-mezzanine and mezzanine-to-platform, lighting, call boxes, HD cameras, safety and wayfinding signage. ~3,000 daily riders.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Drexel Station at 30th Street upgrade
properties.description: Station upgrade cited as an example.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Susquehanna-Dauphin Station upgrade
properties.description: Station upgrade cited as an example.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: New Bus Network
properties.program: A New Era of Bus Travel
properties.description: Bus network redesign: 21 newly frequent routes (15 min or better, 7 days), route extensions and realignments; 800,000 more people within 1/4 mile of frequent bus.
properties.location_note: The 21 frequent routes are not listed in the document.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: New Route 72 (Cheltenham Avenue)
properties.program: A New Era of Bus Travel
properties.description: New bus route along Cheltenham Avenue.
properties.location_note: Drawn along Cheltenham Ave; route termini are not given in the document.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: New Route 76 (Olney to Pennsport)
properties.program: A New Era of Bus Travel
properties.description: New bus route connecting Olney and Pennsport.
properties.location_note: Endpoints only (Olney TC, Pennsport); alignment not given in the document.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: SEPTA GO on-demand zones
properties.program: A New Era of Bus Travel
properties.description: Three on-demand SEPTA GO zones in high-need areas.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Bus stop signs and ePaper displays
properties.program: A New Era of Bus Travel
properties.description: Replace tens of thousands of bus stop signs; 10 solar ePaper displays debuted in 2026, location studies for 90 more.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Trolley fleet replacement (130 low-floor LRVs)
properties.description: Replace the 40-year-old trolley fleet with 130 accessible low-floor light rail vehicles.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Trolley stations and corridors
properties.description: Accessible stations with shelters, seating, real-time info and wayfinding; enhanced tunnel stations; sidewalk and separated bike lane improvements; stop consolidation and signal priority; 5-min peak on T, 15-min peak on D.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: New L Line subway cars and signal system
properties.description: New Market-Frankford cars arriving from 2029 (open gangways, wider doors) and new signal system; up to 3-minute headways.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: New B Line vehicles
properties.description: Replace 125 B-IV cars that are 40+ years old.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: New M Line vehicles
properties.description: Replace the 26-car Norristown High Speed Line fleet in service since 1993.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Metro Station Improvement Program
properties.description: Elevators at every Metro station, new headhouses, waterproofing, lighting, communications and safety systems; full accessibility at every Metro station.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Silverliner VI Regional Rail fleet
properties.description: Replace the 50-year-old Silverliner IV fleet with Silverliner VI cars, 2030-2035: level boarding, bike storage, 35% faster boarding.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Schuylkill-to-Suburban Reconstruction
properties.description: Repair Schuylkill River bridge, rehab bridge over CSX, repair 23rd St Viaduct, replace 22nd and 21st St bridges, rebuild 20th St Interlocking, reconfigure junctions for through-running. 400+ trains, 90,000+ daily riders.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Wissahickon Transit Center
properties.description: New shelters, lighting and operator facilities; 7,000 daily riders on 11 routes.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: South Philadelphia Transit Center
properties.description: Dual-site transit center at Pier 70 and South Front Street connecting 7 routes and consolidating ends-of-line.
properties.location_note: South Front St site location approximate.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Camera-Assisted Transit Enforcement
properties.description: Camera enforcement of bus/trolley lanes with the PPA on 16 bus routes and T and G trolleys.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Bus lane and corridor program
properties.description: Up to 25 new miles of bus lanes plus enhanced stops, transit signal priority and safer streets.
properties.location_note: Corridors beyond Olney Ave, Roosevelt Blvd and Route 47 not named.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Olney Avenue bus corridor
properties.description: Block-long bus lanes, queue jumps, reconfigured intersections; 20,000 daily riders.
properties.location_note: Corridor extent not specified; drawn Ogontz Ave to Front St.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Roosevelt Boulevard bus lanes
properties.description: Nearly 15 miles of new bus lanes from Frankford Transit Center to the far Northeast.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Route 47 transit priority
properties.description: Transit signal priority and upgraded stops on narrow streets.
properties.location_note: Drawn along 5th St, Whitman Plaza to Olney Ave.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Conshohocken Station TOD
properties.description: 300-unit residential complex on 6.5 acres with cafe; $332M revenue over a 99-year lease.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Ambler Station TOD
properties.description: Redevelop surface parking into mixed-use infill.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Germantown Station TOD
properties.description: Redevelop 120-128 East Chelten Avenue.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: 69th Street Transit Center TOD and South Terminal
properties.description: Mixed-use development with South Terminal bus facility renovation; D and L connections.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Regional Rail Master Plan (15-minute network)
properties.description: 47% more trains per week than 2019; nearly half of 150+ stations with 15-min service 7 days a week; 75 miles of new frequent rail.
properties.location_note: Station-level list is in map graphics not readable from the PDF text.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: S Lines: three new 15-minute Regional Rail services
properties.description: Three new 15-minute S Line services to Airport, Wawa, Fox Chase, Paoli, Chestnut Hill East and Norristown.
properties.location_note: Pairing of endpoints into the three S Lines not specified in the text.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Accessible, integrated Regional Rail network
properties.description: 100% accessible Regional Rail; integrated transfers with bus and Metro; fare integration with Amtrak, NJ Transit and PATCO.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: 15th Street/City Hall Station (L) renovation
properties.description: New elevators, lighting, finishes and Ray King art installation.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: City Hall Station (B) renovation
properties.description: New fare gates, attendant booths, refinished stairwells and flooring.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Paoli Station
properties.description: High-level, accessible station.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)

properties.name: Crum Creek Viaduct replacement
properties.description: $89.9M replacement of the 1895 viaduct.
properties.source: SEPTA Accelerate: Best-in-Class Vision for a Greater Philadelphia Region (Sept 2026)
